desc:
Like after playing to keep the game open for longer!

Modifiers available in private servers!

Update 8/12/2026:
- Nerfed speed for tools that speed you up in public servers specifically, unchanged in private servers.
- Fixed the jump & added a option to revert it
- More changes to Dialogue
- MoonJug is now group exclusive
- Fixed body not following where you look
- Fixed item drop issues
- Fixed lots of bugs
- You can now see others minecart
- Play Again button now teleports you back to the game
- Added Settings, Cinematic Mode
- Seek now chases in minecart phase + speeds up when you're far
- New animation when interacting with the generator
- Minecart not moving fixed

Minecart is still not finished!
The room generation may have issues!
Grumble nest will not be added for many reasons!

Join the group to report any bugs or suggest modifiers

Credits to LSPLASH!
